title: Initiates at Eleusis came away believing they were immortal

tellings.quote: People went to Eleusis as human beings, they walked away thinking they were immortal.

plain: People who went through the secret rites at Eleusis, a sacred site in ancient Greece, are said to have arrived as ordinary humans and left believing they were immortal. An unnamed speaker says this in a clip played on the show. It is offered as a sign that the rites gave people some powerful experience of life beyond death.
